user.title: Set up DHL Tracking
user.description: Enter your DHL API key from the DHL Developer Portal. Tracking numbers are optional - you can add and remove them later at any time via the integration options or the dhl_tracking.add_shipment action.

data_description.api_key: Create an app for the "Shipment Tracking - Unified" API at developer.dhl.com.
data_description.tracking_numbers: One number per line or separated by commas.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate DHL Tracking
reauth_confirm.description: The DHL API rejected the stored API key. Enter a valid key to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the DHL API. Please try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The DHL API rejected this API key.
error.rate_limited: The DHL API rate limit is currently exceeded. Please try again later.
error.invalid_tracking_number: At least one tracking number has an invalid format.
error.empty_tracking_number: A tracking number must not be empty.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This DHL API key is already configured.

init.title: DHL Tracking
init.description: Manage the tracked shipments and the polling behaviour.

add_shipment.title: Add shipment
add_shipment.description: Spaces in the tracking number are removed automatically.

data_description.name: Used as the device name of the shipment. Can be changed later without recreating entities.
data_description.recipient_postal_code: Required by DHL for the full set of data on parcel-de and parcel-nl shipments.

edit_shipment.title: Edit shipment
edit_shipment.description: Select the shipment you want to edit.

edit_details.title: Edit shipment
edit_details.description: Editing {tracking_number}. The tracking number itself cannot be changed - remove the shipment and add it again instead.

remove_shipment.title: Remove shipments
remove_shipment.description: The selected shipments and all their entities are removed.

settings.title: Update settings
settings.description: The DHL developer plan allows about 250 API calls per day and there is no batch endpoint, so every shipment costs one call per poll. The integration never polls more often than the daily budget allows, even if a shorter interval is configured here.

data.poll_delivered: Keep polling delivered shipments (once a day)

data_description.scan_interval: Minimum 5 minutes. With several shipments the effective interval is stretched automatically to stay inside the daily request budget.
data_description.poll_delivered: Disable this to stop spending API calls on shipments that were already delivered.
data_description.auto_remove_delivered_days: 0 keeps delivered shipments forever. Otherwise a shipment is removed once its delivery is this many days in the past.

add_shipment.name: Add shipment
add_shipment.description: Adds a tracking number at runtime. The shipment is stored permanently and its entities appear without restarting Home Assistant.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The DHL tracking number. Spaces are removed automatically.

name.name: Display name
name.description: Optional name used for the shipment device, for example "Spare part".

recipient_postal_code.name: Recipient postal code
recipient_postal_code.description: Optional postal code of the delivery address. DHL requires it for the full set of data on parcel-de and parcel-nl shipments.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one DHL Tracking entry is configured.

remove_shipment.name: Remove shipment
remove_shipment.description: Removes a tracking number and all of its entities. Fails with a clear error when the number is not tracked.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one DHL Tracking entry is configured.

remove_delivered_shipments.name: Remove delivered shipments
remove_delivered_shipments.description: Removes all shipments whose delivery is at least the given number of days in the past. Returns the list of removed tracking numbers.

older_than_days.name: Delivered at least this many days ago

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one DHL Tracking entry is configured.
